Reviewer A claims: Location: docs/configuration/configuration.md and docs/feature_flags.md

Reviewer A claims: Consider removing the feature flag entirely in the next major version

Reviewer A claims: Add more prominent warnings in configuration docs about the backward compatibility implications of using XOR2 encoding
